hook: Newly unsealed records from October 2026 reveal a secret informant helped O.J. Simpson.

sections.voiceover: Newly unsealed records from October 2026 reveal a secret informant helped O.J. Simpson.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of sealed court document being opened with redacted lines visible.

sections.voiceover: In 1994, Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman were killed outside a Los Angeles residence. The New York Times published a report detailing federal files on the case. What did this mob informant do?
sections.visual_cue: Historical newspaper headline from 1994 panning across the screen.
b_roll: The New York Times office exterior

sections.voiceover: Fox News revealed sealed records showing how the drug smuggler aided the cover-up.
sections.visual_cue: Archival footage of Fox News broadcast studio monitor.

sections.voiceover: Simpson wrote about getting help in 'If I Did It'. He detailed a friend disposing of the weapon. That informant died in 2006.
sections.visual_cue: Cover of the book 'If I Did It' resting on a dark wooden desk.
